js: document.querySelector('#planshetSearch').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); const i=document.querySelector('#planshet .p-search-field input'); i.value='роботов'; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); i.blur(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); const groups=[...document.querySelectorAll('#planshet .results .group')].map(g=>({h:g.querySelector('h3')?.textContent, n:g.querySelectorAll('.row').length, pins:g.querySelectorAll('.res-map').length})); return groups;

const g=[...document.querySelectorAll('#planshet .results .group')].find(g=>g.querySelector('h3')?.textContent==='В тексте'); window.__t=[...g.querySelectorAll('.row-title')].map(n=>n.textContent).slice(0,3); g.querySelector('.row').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,3500)); const b=document.querySelector('.find-bar'); const cur=document.querySelector('mark.find-cur'); const r=cur?.getBoundingClientRect(); return {first3:window.__t, bar:b?.textContent, marks:document.querySelectorAll('mark.find-hit').length, curY:r&&Math.round(r.top), curText:cur?.textContent};

const n=document.querySelectorAll('mark.find-hit').length; for(let k=0;k<n-1;k++){document.querySelector('.find-next').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,150));} return document.querySelector('.find-bar')?.textContent;

document.querySelector('.find-close').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Escape',bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); return {bar:!!document.querySelector('.find-bar'), marks:document.querySelectorAll('mark.find-hit').length, open:[...document.querySelectorAll('.phenom-overlay.open')].map(o=>o.id), resultsVisible:!document.querySelector('#planshet').hidden && !document.querySelector('#planshet .results').hidden};

const pin=document.querySelector('#planshet .results .res-map'); pin?.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2500)); return {searchOpen:!document.querySelector('#planshet .p-search')?.hidden, surfaceHidden:document.querySelector('#planshet').hidden};
